notes: v2.9.23: keeps the v2.9.22 single-click nonblocking condition-search pipeline and hardens partial-failure recovery. When one or more of the seven day-search initial refreshes time out or fail after retries, successful searches are refreshed normally while the failed search keeps its previous active candidates instead of deleting them. Any partial rows already returned are merged and realtime I/D events continue reconciling the pool. This prevents transient Kiwoom errors from shrinking or blanking the combined day-trading candidate list; trading rules are unchanged.
